blocks.html:
1. Home
  2. Tools
  3. Project estimator
Answer a few questions to build a scoped brief: what you need, the effort band and why, and what we need from you. Only the service is required.
This is a scoped brief, not a quote and not a delivery-date promise.
Your answers stay in your browser and are not sent anywhere.
This tool needs JavaScript to work. The page content is readable without it; for an estimate, use the contact page.
How this band is worked out

items: A question not shown for your service, or left unanswered, scores 0 and appears in the brief as "Not answered".
A fixed date does not make the band larger; it is listed under risks.
Interest in a penetration test alongside another service does not change the band; penetration testing always gets its own fixed-scope proposal.
A band is the rough size of the work, not a price and not a duration. A fixed price is set only after a scoping conversation, in a written proposal.
